content.text: Al Van Der LaanFirst of all, he was a great icon; there are so many memes about him that make you laugh. He has earned his stripes here on earth, and now he is in Heaven. And as we say, the devil fled once Chuck showed up to the gates.Summer DeyVerified account I actually knew him. My mom dated him when I was a freshman. Wrote a tribute to him with my favorite memories of him on my page you can read.6Joy HigginsI have got a feeling that Chuck's next job will be the five star general who will accompany Jesus Christ at the battle of Armageddon!Ruth TolandChuck told God he was coming n God rolled out the red carpet!6Scott IceI have a great relationship with myself. Does that count?2Tema Miller-SheltonBest words and example from Chuck Norris was not his acting career or records set in his karate skills, although I love his show Walker Texas Ranger..But his Acknowledgment and Profession of Jesus as His Lord and Savior God is shows no favoritism towards man, due to earthly status.God Bless Chucks family 4Paul CavinI sparred with him at his karate dojo, we'll go a few more when I see him in Heaven.Luigia Bancheri McfarlandWhenever someone passes away—celebrity or not—I always find myself saying, ‘I hope they knew the Lord.’ I’m grateful that Chuck was a believer in Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior. See you in heaven, brother. 3Philip ParrinoWe can feel sad that Chuck is not with us or his family. But we can also be happy that he is in Heaven with his beloved Savior. See you later, Mr. Norris.20Tim ReppenChuck Norris wasn't afraid of Death, Death was afraid of Chuck Norris. RIP2
